label: Turn this pair left
helper: Turn this pair left rotates both velocities a quarter turn left. Neither bird moves until a beat. Step back restores both flights.
output: pair-left edits only the neighboring flights before a reversible beat

label: Turn this pair right
helper: Turn this pair right rotates both velocities a quarter turn right. Neither bird moves until a beat. Step back restores both flights.
output: pair-right edits only the neighboring flights before a reversible beat

label: Turn this pair around
helper: Turn this pair around reverses both velocities. Their speeds and positions stay the same. Step back restores both flights.
output: pair-reverse edits only the neighboring flights before a reversible beat

label: Slow this pair by half
helper: Slow this pair by half halves both velocities. It leaves the rest of the sky at its current pace. One beat shows the local difference; Step back restores both flights.
output: pair-half edits only the neighboring flights before a reversible beat

label: Rest only the nearest
helper: Rest only the nearest sets the nearest neighbor’s velocity to zero. This bird keeps its flight, and neither position changes. Step back restores the neighbor’s flight.
output: rest-nearest edits only the neighboring flights before a reversible beat

label: Give nearest this flight
helper: Give nearest this flight copies this bird’s velocity to its nearest neighbor. This bird keeps its own flight. The edit does not add a new flock rule; Step back restores the neighbor’s flight.
output: teach-nearest edits only the neighboring flights before a reversible beat
